parameters: In battle\.\., you will see different actions that you can take.\!
You won't be using any skill attacks\| because you don't have any yet.
Anyways let's start by taking a look at \c[31]\i[76]Attack\c[0].\.\.
To Attack\.\., you have to perform an \c[31]Action Wheel\c[0].\! What is an Action wheel?\!
An \c[31]Action Wheel\c[0]\.\. is a wheel where you have to \c[31]time four-button presses to do damage\c[0].\!
But be careful\.\., the \c[31]four buttons are randomized on which ones you have to press\c[0].
The buttons you'll be pressing are \c[31]"\i[1743]"\c[0] and \c[31]"\i[1744]"\c[0] on your keyboard.
\}(Unless you change them in the options menu.)
Nice!\! You may have noticed\.\., but depending on how well you do an Action command\.\., you'll get a rating.\!
The \c[31]better rating\c[0]\.\., the \c[31]more damage\c[0] you'll do.
Let's move on to the next thing.\|
To Dodge\.\., you have to \c[31]fill the Dodge meter to 30% or more and then let go of the button so you can dodge\c[0].
Be careful\.\.\., you can't just hold it down forever\.\. because when it gets to \c[31]100% full\.\., it slowly empties\c[0].\!
You also have to time it as well.\! Young one\.\., I'm going to hit you.\|
I want you to \c[31]time it a bit after when you see the screen flash blue or when you hear a ding sound\c[0].
Remember\.\., \c[31]new attacks may have different tells\c[0].\! Some moves might have louder or quieter dings\.\.\.,
and some moves may or may not have a flash of blue on the screen.\!
So\.\., always \c[31]listen for that ding sound\c[0]\.\., or when you see a flash of blue.
To fill the meter just hold the button \c[31]"\i[1743]"\c[0] on your keyboard.
1st: Hold the button and fill the meter.\!
2nd: Let go of the button to dodge.
This may seem tricky when you try it\.\.\., but once you get the hang of it.
Now try \c[31]Dodging\c[0] when you get the chance.
\lsn<Butterfly_Blip_1>Alright.\.\. Hopefully\.\., you understand it a bit better now.\!
For the sake of this lesson\.\., let's move on.
\lsn<Butterfly_Blip_1>Look\..\..\.. at the end of the lesson\..\..\.. I'll let you practice some more if you need it.
When guarding\.\., you block half the damage taken\.\., but that is not the only thing it does.\!
Watch your \c[31]EP Bar\c[0] and see what happens when you try \c[31]guarding\c[0].
Nice!\.\. Did you see what happens to your \c[31]EP Bar?\c[0]\! When you guarded\.\., you gain some \c[31]EP\c[0]\. which stands
for \c[31]Energy Power\c[0].\. Which will come in handy later on.
Oh!\| I'm not sure if you noticed\.\.\., but when \c[31]you attacked\.\.\., you also gained EP\c[0].\!
Another thing\.\., you can also \c[31]dodge while you're guarding\c[0].\!
Don't just sit there and take the damage!\|
Now for the last command\.\.,\c[31]\i[321]Items!\c[0]\! It's pretty self-explanatory.\|
You can use \c[31]Items to heal and do other interesting effects\c[0].
Here\|, have one of my apples if you want to try using\c[31]\i[321]Items\c[0].
The \c[27]Pink Butterfly\c[0] gave you an Apple! \i[265]
\lsn<Butterfly_Blip_1>And there you go!\| Young one\.\., that is how battles function.
Oh\.\., I almost forgot\.\., when defeating an enemy\.\., you get \c[31]EXP\c[0].\!
When you \c[31]get enough EXP\.\., you'll Level Up\c[0]!\!
One last thing\.\., when you \c[31]defeat an enemy\.\., you also get \i[2176]Abyss Points\c[0]\.\..
Abyss Points are used to get new\..\.\..\.\..\.\| something\..\.\..\.\..\.\|
I actually don't know\.\.\., but I'm sure you'll find out soon enough.
